planets.name: Sun

planets.positiveOutcome: confidence, authority, recognition, leadership, and clarity of purpose
planets.negativeOutcome: ego clashes, pride, dominance issues, or strain with authority figures

ratna.purpose: Strengthens Sun when Sun is suitable and needs support in the chart.

upratna.purpose: Budget alternative for Sun strengthening.

upratna.purpose: Alternative gemstone for Sun energy.

japa.mantra: Om Hram Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah

remedies.caution: Ruby should be recommended only if Sun is functionally suitable for the chart. Do not recommend only because Sun is weak.
